revisionLog.change: Frozen the full historical robustness window to 2021-05-01 through 2026-03-01 and clarified that the funding payment timestamp coincident with entry is not earned. No result had been observed.

Changed spot-price provenance from monthly to checksum-verified daily Binance Vision 8h klines after identifying open Binance public-data issue #475, where some monthly spot archives disagree with daily archives/API. Strategy, dates, costs, sizing, and evaluation rules are unchanged.

strategyFamily: market-neutral spot/perpetual funding and basis carry
motivation: Evaluate a genuinely different, low-turnover return source after the directional ridge robustness failure. This is not a rescue or parameter modification of trial 1.

requiredSeries: spot price at entry, every funding timestamp, and exit
USD-M perpetual mark or executable price at entry, every funding timestamp, and exit
realized 8-hour funding rate at every payment timestamp

primarySources.spot: checksum-verified Binance Vision DAILY BTCUSDT 8h spot klines; use the exact kline open at each funding timestamp
primarySources.perpetualMark: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M BTCUSDT 8h markPriceKlines
primarySources.funding: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M BTCUSDT fundingRate archives

dataRequirements.spotDailyReason: Binance public-data issue #475 reports historical monthly SPOT kline disagreements where daily archives match API/uiKlines. Daily spot archives are therefore frozen as the primary source before any carry result is observed.
dataRequirements.secondaryIntegrityCheck: Torch-Trade BTCUSDT 8h funding dataset sourced from Binance Data Collection
rejectEvaluationIf: spot and perpetual timestamps cannot be synchronized exactly without forward-looking interpolation
funding observations are missing around an open position or the realized series is not a complete 8-hour grid
perpetual mark/executable prices are unavailable for basis P&L and margin stress
any downloaded archive fails its official Binance .CHECKSUM verification
the exact synchronized input cannot be hashed

historicalRobustnessWindow.entryTimestampRule: use the first synchronized observation at or after startInclusive
historicalRobustnessWindow.exitTimestampRule: use the final synchronized observation strictly before endExclusive
historicalRobustnessWindow.priceTimestampRule: use the exact 8-hour kline open at the realized funding timestamp; do not use that bar's close/high/low or any later observation
historicalRobustnessWindow.fundingAtEntry: not earned; the first synchronized row establishes the position and mark only
historicalRobustnessWindow.fundingAfterEntry: accrue only realized funding payments on later synchronized timestamps
historicalRobustnessWindow.reason: Use the entire common historical interval motivated before any carry P&L was observed rather than selecting favorable subperiods. Whole-sample funding summary statistics were already visible, so this is robustness/development evidence only.

candidate.position: long BTC spot and short equal BTC units of BTCUSDT perpetual
candidate.entryRule: enter once at the beginning of the frozen historical robustness window; no forecast threshold and no funding-sign timing
candidate.exitRule: exit both legs at the end of the frozen historical robustness window
candidate.rebalancing: none; keep equal BTC units on both legs so first-order BTC delta remains offset
candidate.fundingAccounting: after entry, at each later realized funding timestamp, short receives positive funding and pays negative funding on contemporaneous perpetual notional; no payment at the entry timestamp is credited
candidate.basisAccounting: mark both legs independently; net price P&L must include spot/perpetual entry and exit basis rather than assuming convergence or perfect cancellation

costModel.note: The same conservative MoneyMog friction is applied to both legs for the first research pass rather than assuming institutional futures fees or perfect maker fills.

marginStress.liquidationRule: fail the strategy at the first timestamp where futures collateral plus accumulated futures P&L and funding falls below maintenance margin

evaluation.historicalHoldoutIntegrity: Any historical result using the frozen 2021-05-01 through 2026-03-01 window is development/robustness evidence, not pristine validation, because whole-sample funding summary statistics were viewed before this manifest was frozen.
evaluation.promotionRequires: a later untouched forward or independently sealed evaluation in addition to positive net-of-cost historical robustness

antiRescueRule: No funding threshold, sign filter, leverage change, entry date selection, or rebalancing rule may be introduced after seeing this candidate's first result under trial 2. Any such change is a new numbered trial.
